# PR-head provisioning: acme/widget#82 (fix/retry), singleton runs

## Legend

**Aliases**
- `ROOT=/work/widget`
- `W=/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry`
- `A=aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa`
- `B=bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb`
- `C=cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc`
- `D=dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd`
- Short forms are the first 7 characters (`aaaaaaa`).

**Discovery (D1–D6)**, run from the session cwd:
- **D1** `git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-dir --git-common-dir` gives `ROOT` as `dirname(GIT_COMMON)`.
- **D2** `git -C ROOT rev-parse --show-superproject-working-tree` prints nothing, so this is not a submodule.
- **Routing:** caller PR values route to `pr-head.md`, which replaces Steps 0/1. There is no reuse of a linked tree.
- **Home:** the overrides ladder finds no file. No native tool or wrapper exists. The home is the default `W` (`<name>=fix-retry`).
- **D3** `git -C ROOT fetch origin`
- **D4** `git -C ROOT rev-parse --verify -q A^{commit}` and `git -C ROOT rev-parse origin/fix/retry` (must equal `A`).
- **D5** `git -C ROOT rev-parse origin/main` gives `BASE_SHA=B`.
- **D6** `git -C ROOT worktree list --porcelain`
- **Stop order:** fork, elsewhere, unreachable/moved, local ancestry.
- **N=1 checks:** no `refs/gauntlet/rework-base/pr-82` exists. No members means no canonical-merge recovery, so the ancestry check always applies.

**Fresh-creation steps (F1–F3):**
- **F1** `git -C ROOT status --porcelain` is clean.
- **F2** `git -C ROOT check-ignore -q .worktrees` exits 0 (ignored), so there is no gitignore commit.
- **F3** `git -C ROOT symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD` prints nothing, so the provenance note is skipped.

**Success steps (S1–S6):**
- **S1** `git -C ROOT worktree list --porcelain` shows `worktree W`.
- **S2** `git -C W branch --show-current` prints `fix/retry`.
- **S3** `git -C W rev-parse HEAD` equals `A`. This captures `PRE_REWORK_HEAD=A` and `BASE_SHA=B`.
- **S4** `git -C W update-ref refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-82 A`
- **S5** (SYNC=merge, no members) `git -C W merge --no-ff --no-edit origin/main` records `merge: no-op - head contains origin/main`. No commit is made and no rework-base ref is written.
- **S6** `git -C W merge-base --is-ancestor A HEAD` exits 0.

**Report R:**
```
Worktree ready at /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry
Branch: fix/retry
Base: fix/retry @ aaaaaaa
PR: acme/widget#82
Pre-rework head: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
Base SHA: bbbbbbb
merge: no-op - head contains origin/main
Ready to implement PR #82 rework
```

**DWIM checkout:** `git -C ROOT worktree add W fix/retry`. Git resolves the unique remote branch as `--track -b fix/retry W origin/fix/retry`. The caller never passes `-b`.

## Provisioning rows

| Row | Delta from legend | Outcome / boundary |
|---|---|---|
| linked | D1 gives `GIT_COMMON=/work/widget/.git`, so `ROOT` is the same. The `other` tree is ignored. Runs D2–D6, F1–F3, DWIM checkout, S1–S6. | R. A new tree at `W`, not nested in or reusing `other`. |
| primary | Same commands as linked. | R. |
| ancestor | D6 lists no worktree. `git -C ROOT merge-base --is-ancestor fix/retry origin/fix/retry` exits 0. Then F1–F3, `git -C ROOT update-ref refs/heads/fix/retry origin/fix/retry` (never `branch -f`), `git -C ROOT worktree add W fix/retry` (existing branch), S1–S6. | R. |
| reuse | Recovery probes `git -C W rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path rebase-merge` and `git -C W rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path rebase-apply`; neither path is a directory. Ancestry `git -C ROOT merge-base --is-ancestor fix/retry origin/fix/retry` exits 0. `git -C W status --porcelain` is clean. `git -C W merge --ff-only origin/fix/retry` moves `ccccccc` to `aaaaaaa`. Then S1–S6. No F-steps (not fresh). | R. |
| fork | Stops at D4 order position 1. | `PR #82's head lives on fork contributor/widget; rework needs an in-repo branch.` Only the fetch ran. No file, add, or ref writes. |
| elsewhere | D6 lists fix/retry at `/work/widget/.worktrees/pr-82`. | `branch fix/retry is checked out at /work/widget/.worktrees/pr-82; finish or remove that worktree first.` Pre-write. |
| unreachable | D4's `--verify` fails. | `PR #82 head aaaaaaa is not reachable (origin/fix/retry is at ddddddd); the branch moved.` Pre-write. |
| moved | D4: the head exists, but `origin/fix/retry` resolves to `D`. | Same stop text as unreachable. Pre-write. |
| ahead | `git -C ROOT merge-base --is-ancestor fix/retry origin/fix/retry` exits 1. | `local branch fix/retry is at ccccccc, not an ancestor of origin/fix/retry (aaaaaaa); rework needs the PR head.` Pre-write. No update-ref. |
| diverged | Same as ahead. | Same stop. Pre-write. |
| override | The overrides `## using-git-worktrees` has `create: helper create -b <branch> <name>`. It contains `-b`, so it is skipped. Runs F1–F3, DWIM checkout, S1–S6. | R plus `create: override skipped (contains -b)`. |
| race | DWIM checkout succeeds, but S3 returns `D`. | Stop: `worktree /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry HEAD dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd != PR #82 head aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa; tree left intact.` This is post-add. There is no S4 ref, sync, report, removal, or reset. |
| control | Ordinary singleton run. Local fix/retry is a clean two-parent base-sync merge. Ancestry exits 1. No rework-base ref exists and N=1 has no members, so no recovery applies. | The ahead stop text. Pre-write. |

## History

Merge-forward mode keeps `A` as an ancestor of every later tip (checked by S6). It writes no rework-base ref and never resets, cleans, or force-moves the branch. The flow may still:
- amend the approved appended spec with `commit --amend --no-edit`, and
- fold an appended wave with `reset --soft "$WAVE_BASE_SHA"`,

provided `WAVE_BASE_SHA` descends from `PRE_REWORK_HEAD=A`. `refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-82` stays at `A` in every successful row.
